source.undetected: The browser time zone could not be detected; Turkey time is used

zone.intro: If you calculate transits for Turkey time, you do not need to select any location or time zone. If you want to calculate for the local date and time of another country, select the relevant city or time zone. The system automatically calculates the correct time, taking the selected region's past and current daylight-saving rules into account.
zone.cityPlaceholder: Type a city… (e.g. London, New York, Tokyo)
zone.cityHint: Select a city from the list; unselected text does not change the time zone.
zone.cityTzError: The time zone of this location could not be verified; please select the time zone from the list.

errors.DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The date must be between 01.01.1900 and 31.12.2100.
errors.LOCAL_TIME_GAP: Because of a daylight-saving change, this local time did not occur in the selected time zone. Choose an hour later.
errors.LOCAL_TIME_AMBIGUOUS: Because of a daylight-saving change, this local time occurred twice in the selected time zone. Choose which moment you mean.
errors.MOMENT_MISMATCH: The server response did not match the selected moment; no result was shown. Please try again.
errors.PERSONAL_MISMATCH: The server response did not match the selected client / moment; no result was shown. Please try again.

page.demo: Transit calculations are not performed in the demo account. You can review verified ready-made examples on the Clients, Saved Charts and Relationship & Group screens.

notes.general: This is not a birth chart: these are the general Human Design activations of the planetary positions at the selected moment. No type, authority or profile is assigned to a person. The planets move constantly; the Moon in particular can change gates within a few hours, so the result applies only to the moment shown.
notes.uncertain: Could not be confirmed: this planet is closer to a line boundary than the measured precision of the calculation method. Two possible gate.line values are shown; channels and centers depending on this activation are not presented as certain. You can resolve it by choosing a moment a few minutes earlier or later.
notes.nearBoundary: Near a boundary: the position is very close to a line boundary; a difference of a few minutes may change the gate or line.
notes.personal: A personal transit places the planetary activations of the selected moment on top of the client's saved Human Design analysis. The saved individual analysis does not change. The transit influence is temporary and applies only to the moment shown.
